reviews.title: Lost my progress
reviews.text: My entire calendar for the year just disappeared with the new update. Great job, guys.

reviews.title: Why do I need to log in every day???
reviews.text: It’s very annoying that every time I go in to log finishing a book that I’ve always started a one day streak. Ridiculous. I read daily but don’t finish a book every day. I have a full time job. That’s dumb. I like the calendar, that’s about it.

reviews.title: Ads & Not Much to Offer
reviews.text: This app has so little to offer compared to how many ads it forces on you and for it to have a premium service. StoryGraph is worlds better as an alternative to Goodreads.

reviews.title: Pop ups
reviews.text: The two seperate pop ups you have to close out of EVERY time you open this app are horrid. I will be switching off to a different app to track my reading

reviews.title: Bad app
reviews.text: Paying $30 for a subscription of an app that does not sync my books is bad. I have to manually add my books.

reviews.title: Just a PITA
reviews.text: I never knew an app that likes their users to be inconvenienced!  Because I don’t pay the $40 subscription fee to sync devices and not have to back up, really they are just inconveniencing their users to back up manually.  So really their $40 fee is just an inconvenience fee.  How nice of them!

reviews.title: Good but annoying
reviews.text: The free version is fine but the endless sitting thru annoying ads just to log progress is getting ridiculous.

reviews.title: Terrible
reviews.text: Very hard to find books.. I won’t be renewing… Never had as app that is so hard to navigate

reviews.title: Twists
reviews.text: Freida McFadden is good at putting a great twist in her stories.  I did not see this one coming.
